posts.text:
Justices Kagan and Barrett are testifying before Congress today—about the Court’s budget.

It’ll be the first time a justice has appeared before the legislature since 2019—even though the practice used to be (and *ought* to be) a lot more common:

In "One First," me on how this happened (and why it's allowed but shouldn't be):
